paragraphs.text: "Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her Gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"The Matrons are kindly souls, but don't ask one for an ale." —Halina, Dwarven Trader
"The Matrons still say Serra is coming back. I bet she never even existed." —Murat, Death Speaker
"I would say that our Bureaucrats are no better than vipers—but I shouldn't insult the vipers." —Murat, Death Speaker
"All the tortures of my vault of horrors pale in comparison to dealing with those petty Bureaucrats." —Baron Sengir
"A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true Crusader make." —Irini Sengir
"Tread the roads of righteousness, Murat, lest you lose your way and be consumed." —Baris, Serra Inquisitor
"The Beast Walkers do a great service to Aysen. As humans or as beasts, their heart is yet to Serra true." —Baris, Serra Inquisitor
"Such innocent little birds. They sing a sweet song, sitting on their fragile branch." —Grandmother Sengir
"Soon, Serra will return and choose the Abbot's successor, else we are lost." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"Where our potions and powders fail, perhaps nature will succeed." —Reyhan, Samite Alchemist
"The faith of Serra is borne on wings of hope." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"Pretty Falcon, friend to Soraya. Will you send her my greetings?" —Gemma, Willow Priestess
"Rarely be the prey so haughty as to hunt the hunter." —Baron Sengir
"Powders and potions are nothing compared to faith." —Baris, Serra Inquisitor
"The wisest of Aysen dwell not in the Abbey, but in the laboratory." —Taysir
"Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do." —Taysir
"Would that I could be a Paladin again, but the dead hold no place among their ranks." —Ihsan's Shade
"Soraya speaks with the hunters of the air, as do all of her family line." —Autumn Willow
"The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce." —Eron the Relentless
"I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir." —Daria
"Those who fling spells too quickly should have reason to regret it." —Baki, Wizard Attendant
"Here we go again." —Kakra, Sea Troll
"The path of faith is fortunately fraught with failure." —Irini Sengir
"Stray not into the path of darkness, or be lost forever." —Baki, Wizard Attendant
"What wizards upset, the land soon rights." —Gemma, Willow Priestess
"I doubt any Labyrinth Minotaurs still live—but then again, we Minotaurs are stubborn beings." —Onatah, Anaba Shaman
"Legend says they got a treasure cave, but it don't say where to find it." —Zeki, Reef Pirate
"Um . . . oh . . . what was I saying?" —Reveka, Wizard Savant
"Oh, I had a conscience once. But alas, I seem to have forgotten where I put it." —Chandler
"There's no trade without trust." —Eron the Relentless
"Curse Reveka, and curse her coddled conjurers. Their sorcerers' school shall yet be ours." —Irini Sengir
"Who needs a spear? Ya break off the horn, and ya stab the fish with it. Easy!" —Kakra, Sea Troll
"Corpses for crew don't sit well with me. Zeki and his dead ship had best keep their distance." —Joskun, An-Havva Constable
"Zeki sails with a dead crew not out of villainy, but pragmatism." —Baron Sengir
"It's nice to see a sister Dwarf in a position of such power, but why'd it have to be one of those seafaring muleheads?" —Halina, Dwarven Trader
"No one can catch what won't be caught." —Kakra, Sea Troll
"I've seen those Trolls devour a drowning sailor faster than his lungs could fill with water." —Zeki, Reef Pirate
"Ya can eat it or ya can weave it, but ya can't fight in it." —Zeki, Reef Pirate
"Beast. Defiler. The source of all my pain." —Ihsan's Shade
"The Baron's drivers are also driven." —Chandler
"It keeps some out, yes. It also keeps others in!" —Grandmother Sengir
"Just the place for a picnic." —Murat, Death Speaker
"Wherever water is lacking, all things suffer." —Autumn Willow
"My soul thirsts for Serra's salvation, as does my body for life's breath." —Ihsan's Shade
"Some delicacies are not to be savored, save by the callous." —Baron Sengir
"Could there be a fouler act? No doubt the Baron knows of one." —Autumn Willow
"This party is such fun—but it's a shame to mourn just one." —Irini Sengir
"Rarely have power and madness been so delightfully wed as they have in our dear Grandmother." —Baron Sengir
"The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron." —Taysir
"Your headstone is the last page in the book of your life." —Murat, Death Speaker
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra Paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal." —Baris, Serra Inquisitor
"That cruel being brings shame to all her fellow Dwarves and misery to all the land. She is Sengir's daughter in spirit if not in blood." —Reveka, Wizard Savant
"A thankless job, and a death sentence besides." —Eron the Relentless
"They are the eyes of the Baron, and they know your fears." —Ihsan's Shade
"In the face of every one I see the Baron." —Daria
"It helps you pass the time until you die." —Grandmother Sengir
"Oh, they scream, right enough, and plead, too—but the Baron keeps no mercy in his vault of horrors." —Zeki, Reef Pirate
"Poor, foolish Veldrane. He goes wherever the Baron wills him. One day, he'll go to die." —Halina, Dwarven Trader
"Those who hide in hollow towers would do well to remember the rain." —Reyhan, Samite Alchemist
"The people of Aysen built their roads with stones from these wonders. Aliban would be pleased with their ingenuity." —Baki, Wizard Attendant
"Don't these goons have anything better to do?" —Joskun, An-Havva Constable
"Call it a cost of doing business. The best way to protect against thieves is to hire better thieves." —Eron the Relentless
"The roads to Koskun Keep are mostly safe these days. Mostly." —Joskun, An-Havva Constable
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them." —Baron Sengir
"The Ancestors are the wisdom of the tribe and the soul of the Homelands. I am eternally in their debt." —Taysir
"Not all Minotaurs are tribal. Some are freelance." —Eron the Relentless
"Not someone to pick a fight with, unless you're fond of pain." —Halina, Dwarven Trader
"The Shamans? Ha! They are mere craven cows not capable of true magic." —Irini Sengir
"Few master the powers of the earth as well as do the Shamans of the Minotaurs." —Baki, Wizard Attendant
"The Spirit Crafters sing of all our people. They sing of those lost, of those found, and of those who are yet to be." —Onatah, Anaba Shaman
"Never brag about the latest wonder you've created, students. Chandler might be listening." —Reveka, Wizard Savant
"I hear Halina's got a pony that can count to six—and likes to eat meat." —Chandler
"No dwarf alive can best one of my crew dead." —Zeki, Reef Pirate
"Their definition of 'fair profit' is certainly novel." —Reveka, Wizard Savant
"They wouldn't sell their own families—at least, not for cheap." —Zeki, Reef Pirate
"Eron would be much less of a hassle if only he were mortal." —Reyhan, Samite Alchemist
"The body is a temple with a foundation of sand." —Autumn Willow
"Joven, you're almost as good a thief as I. But Eron hates you even more." —Chandler
"Joskun and the other Constables serve with passion, if not with grace." —Devin, Faerie Noble
"The Inn was ever a steady source of good cheer and kindness. Greatly do I miss it, now that I am gone." —Ihsan's Shade
"We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains." —Grandmother Sengir
"The tougher to crack, the sweeter the snack." —Kakra, Sea Troll
"Now, *that's* a fashion statement." —Devin, Faerie Noble
"Those who say that Serra is dead have never met the Autumn Willow's daughters. They are as kind and as generous as Serra would wish us to be." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"Faeries talk all in riddles and tricky bits, 'cept the Nobles. Now, *there's* some straight talkers." —Joskun, An-Havva Constable
"This town's only for good folk. The rest can go to the city." —Joskun, An-Havva Constable
"There are those who accept being told what to do, what to think, and what to say. Then there are the Folk of An-Havva." —Reyhan, Samite Alchemist
"All things must eat, after all. Even the air can hunger." —Gemma, Willow Priestess
"If the air must feed, let it take the self-righteous." —Murat, Death Speaker
"I never question the Autumn Willow about her motives, not even when she turns people into Lizards. It's her way." —Devin, Faerie Noble
"It's strange, but I can feel it when the land is corrupted. I understand why the Autumn Willow is so protective." —Daria
"They're not half as fierce if they don't see you coming." —Devin, Faerie Noble
"That which nourishes can also bind." —Gemma, Willow Priestess
"The smallest beast can yet have the greatest heart." —Gemma, Willow Priestess
"Do not fear adversity. Let your courage be your strength." —Onatah, Anaba Shaman
"I hear there are Bears—or spirits—that guard caravans passing through the forest." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"The Autumn Willow cannot be everywhere at once—that's what her grandchildren are for." —Gulsen, Abbey Matron
"Swift as the wind and harder to catch—that's the Faeries for you." —Daria
"Those of faith are those of strength." —Autumn Willow
"One day, or another, perhaps I shall ring my pretty chime . . . loudly, so that all may hear." —Grandmother Sengir
"Until I came to the Floating Isle, I never had to oil the servants." —Baki, Wizard Attendant
"Play the song of he who delivered us. Play the song of Feroz." —Onatah, Anaba Shaman
"That Rhino would fetch us a tidy sum, Joven. Perhaps it's time to make it ours." —Chandler
"Without the protection of Feroz's Ban, I fear the Homelands are lost." —Daria
"If that thief Joven ever shows his head around here again, make sure he leaves without it." —Eron the Relentless
"The Roterothopter is as insidious as it is ingenious. It is one of the few creations of our school that I take no pride in." —Baki, Wizard Attendant
Folk of good heart will always find a home.
Serra's gift to her people: a symbol of faith and hope.
Where hope has no champion, evil rules all.
Treachery and anarchy make poor partners.
The legacy of Feroz lives on.
